.claude/hooks/complexity_budget.py

1. `complexity_budget.py:399-400` — the same `memo.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` appears three times in a row. With `exist_ok=True` the second and third calls do nothing, so delete them.
2. `complexity_budget.py:453` — `report()` takes a `limits` parameter that its body (lines 455-475) never reads. Drop it here and at the only call, line 511.

.claude/hooks/overseer_phase.py

1. `overseer_phase.py:42` — `set_phase(root, phase)` has one caller (line 68), which always passes `"plan"`, and `main` rejects any other value at line 67. The parameter can become a literal.
2. `overseer_phase.py:38-39` — `state_file()` is a one-line wrapper around `root / STATE_REL`, used only inside this file (lines 43, 50, 60). Inlining it removes a function. This one is marginal; the file is otherwise as small as it should be.

.claude/agents/critic-core.md

1. `critic-core.md:6-8` — the frontmatter description says lenses and algorithm mix differ by level and each critic states its own. Lines 14-16 say the same in the body, and lines 66-67 say it a third time. The description could end after "structural principles".
2. `critic-core.md:44-45` — "never pass to be agreeable" repeats the anti-sycophancy bullet two lines above ("Agreeable is not the job; correct is", line 42). One of the two can go.

The critic-core items are prompt text, so "no behaviour change" is my judgement there, not something checkable. Nothing was edited.
